page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head at top with page number at top left. Continuous text, then a dateline, a rule, a division heading IX with title block, salutation, and opening paragraph beginning with a large initial C.

main_text.p: quam in bono publico promovendo, pari animi candore amanter respondere, cui valetudinem prosperam & rerum a consiliorum salutarium omnium foelicem progressum & eventum, a Deo Opt. Max. omnis foelicitatis autore ex animo vovemus & precamur.
Ex Regia nostra Haderslebiana ipsis idibus Martii. Anno 1584.
main_text.head: IX. LEGATI NAVARRENI EPISTOLA ad DANIÆ REGEM.
Serenissime ac Potentissime REX.

p.i: CUm a Serenissimo Rege Navarreno ad Serenitatem vestram & Illustrissimos Germaniae Principes ablega-

page.notes: The large initial C is printed as a woodcut-style letter and joined to "Um". The dateline "Haderslebiana" and "Anno 1584" are set in mixed type; the word "Haderslebiana" is read with some uncertainty. "ablega-" is a line-end hyphenation continuing on the next page.
